name: gitclaw
description: Gitclaw AI code reviewer: generic review lifecycle, LLM cascade runtime, Cloudflare Worker proxy, and a reusable GitHub Actions workflow. Repository-agnostic — attaching repos provide only a caller workflow and optional policy files.

scripts.build: bun build lifecycle/main.ts --outdir .tmp/gitclaw-main --target bun && bun build lifecycle/qa_sdet.ts --outdir .tmp/gitclaw-qa --target bun && bun build src/worker.ts --outdir .tmp/gitclaw-worker --target bun
